name: Indirect Stretching
summary: Arm extension by buttons: two buttons grow or shrink the virtual arm at a constant rate, giving unlimited reach.
howItWorks: The virtual hand stays on the line from the user's torso through the physical hand; pressing one button lengthens the virtual arm and another shortens it, at a constant rate, until the hand reaches the object to grab.

relationships.note: Arm extension controlled by buttons instead of hand distance.

review.notes: Added from Bowman's 1999 thesis (Oct 2026). Attributes drafted by Claude from the survey descriptions and the original paper's abstract; not yet checked against the paper.
